_about: The prologue: the years before your first memory, told the way families tell them. Each scene sets a place, an age (days after you were born; a year is 120 days), a time of day, who is there and where, captions, and sometimes one choice that shapes who you are. 'you' is the player. walkTo sends someone walking. camera: the point the camera looks at, and how close (zoom, smaller is closer). After the last scene, the game begins at startAge with your first memory.

start.remember: Gran gave you 3 {currency} for your fifth birthday. You were rich.

captions: You were born on a Long Rain night, in the city of Urlivaven.
Gran says you didn't cry. You just looked around, like you were taking notes.

choice.prompt: Ask anyone in your family, and they'll tell you that you were...

options.text: A baby who never, ever slept

captions: Your first steps were out in the yard, wobbling toward Gran's open arms.
You fell, of course. Everybody does. What you did next, Mum still tells people about.

options.text: Got straight back up and tried again
Held out your arms until Gran picked you up
Crawled off and ate one of Gran's flowers

captions: When you were two, Mum went back to work. Early mornings, long days, tired evenings.
So it was Gran who raised you most days. Gran's house, Gran's rules, Gran's songs.

choice.prompt: Gran says that, back then, you were always asking...

captions: By four, Willow Lane was your whole world.
Mrs Pell and her flowers. Mr Ambrose and his jar of sweets. And Nico, the boy from two doors down, who never, ever stopped talking.

choice.prompt: Your favourite thing about the lane was...

options.text: Nico, even when he was annoying

ending: Most of those years, you don't remember. They're stories other people tell you.
But not long after your fifth birthday came a day you would remember for the rest of your life.
